_comment: No config file is required anymore. PrizePicks is read cookie-free from the partner API (see fetch_prizepicks in pullers.py), so the old prizepicks_cookie / _px3 PerimeterX token is no longer used. Any real secrets should go in environment variables (or a gitignored .env), never in a committed file. If a legacy config.json with a cookie still exists locally, it is dead and safe to delete.
